nodes.label: Code 1150 - RATA ADD.REG. A.P.
nodes.rationale: Monthly instalment (8,15) of the prior-year regional surtax. Recurs unchanged on d11, d15, d96, d101-d104 and ago2026, making it the most stable withholding line in the corpus.

nodes.label: IBAN / Bank Accredito Trailer Line
nodes.rationale: Always the last line of the document (IBAN plus bank name), which makes it a reliable end-of-payslip sentinel when splitting multi-payslip PDFs.

nodes.label: Q/INPS - INAIL Statistical Block
nodes.rationale: Row of INPS/INAIL statistics (Q/INPS, POS., SETT., ORE INPS, GG. INPS, GG. MINIM., GG. INAIL, IMPONIBILE INAIL, TFR MESE) emitted as bare integers such as '5 6 168,00 26,00 168,00 25'. Purely statutory reporting -- no dashboard value, but it must be skipped rather than mistaken for money.

nodes.label: Mod. Cedolino TS Layout
nodes.rationale: The TeamSystem payslip form used by every fixture in this chunk. Its defining trait for parsing is that PDF text extraction emits ALL field labels first, as an undelimited header block, and only then the value rows -- so labels cannot be paired with values by adjacency; values must be located positionally in the trailing rows.

nodes.label: PAGA BASE / PREMIO PR. / SUPERM.ASS Row
nodes.rationale: Contractual pay breakdown emitted twice (attuale and precedente). The split shifts between fixtures -- 2.355,13/5,40/254,86 up to May 2026, then 2.555,09/5,40/54,90 from June -- while the total 2.615,39 stays constant, so a change here signals a contract reclassification, not a raise.
nodes.norm_label: paga base / premio pr. / superm.ass row

nodes.label: Teamsystem S.p.A. (payroll provider)
nodes.rationale: Identified by the constant footer line 'Teamsystem S.p.A., Autorizzazione Inail n.341 del 16/01/2009' plus 'Autorizzazione numerazione unitaria n.10213 del 24/12/2008' -- the most reliable format-detection anchor across all real fixtures.

nodes.label: TeamSystem August 2026 Fixture (synthetic-anonymised)
nodes.rationale: Derived from the real August 2026 payslip (Paperless doc 142). Names, tax code, IBAN and employer are replaced; every MONETARY and HOURS value is left untouched because those values are what the tests assert on.

nodes.label: Fixture Anonymisation Convention
nodes.rationale: Every real fixture substitutes identity fields with fixed placeholders -- ACME Consulting srl, VIA CASTELLANZA 11 MILANO, ROSSI MARIO, RSSMRA00A01H501X, Cod.fiscale 0000000000, IBAN IT00X0000000000000000000000 -- while leaving all monetary and hours values untouched, because those values are the object of the tests. Bank names (ING BANK N.V., INTESA SANPAOLO SPA) are left real.

nodes.label: Leave Residuals Grid (FERIE / PERMESSI / ROL / FLESS. / B. ORE)
nodes.rationale: Twelve-column grid of A.P. (carried over), MAT. (accrued), GOD. (used) and RES. (residual) for each leave bucket, all expressed in hours. In the real fixtures it collapses to a bare numeric row such as '7,99 40,02 48,01 22,01 25,98 47,99', so column identity is positional only.

nodes.label: August 2026 OCR Fixture (Paperless-ngx text)
nodes.rationale: Synthetic twin of august-2026.pdf.txt as Paperless-ngx OCR would emit it: whitespace collapsed, digit/letter confusions, residuals grid flattened. Exists to pin the OCR failure modes verified on the real August sample (PLAN section 4). Header notes it MUST be replaced with real anonymised OCR text before M6 ships.

nodes.label: Garbage OCR Fixture (skewed scan)
nodes.rationale: Unreadable OCR output. Encodes the 'Failure handling' contract of PLAN section 4: the pipeline must degrade to an all-low-confidence row for assisted manual entry and never throw.

nodes.label: OCR Digit/Letter Confusion
nodes.rationale: O/0 substitutions corrupt amounts in place ('3.OOO,OO' for 3.000,00, '2O152' for 20152, 'NETTO BUSTA 2.O35,8O'). Numeric normalisation therefore has to fold letter O to zero inside amount tokens before parsing, or every total on an OCR'd payslip fails to parse.

nodes.label: Flattened Residuals Grid OCR Defect
nodes.rationale: Verified on the real August sample (PLAN section 4): OCR emits only 6 values under 12 headers, so leave columns cannot be matched by count. The parser must not assume a full 12-value row and must degrade the unmatched buckets rather than mis-assign them.

nodes.label: All-Low-Confidence Degradation (Failure Handling)
nodes.rationale: Contract from PLAN section 4 'Failure handling': on unreadable input the pipeline emits an all-low-confidence row for assisted manual entry and never throws. Even the format anchors are corrupted ('M0d, (edn|ino T5', 'R3PLy 5.p./-\'), so detection itself must be allowed to fail softly.

nodes.label: OCR Letter-Spacing Artifact (S -> 'S ')
nodes.rationale: Several real fixtures (d10-d15) split letters with spurious spaces: 'NETTO BUS TA', 'TOTALE CONTRIBUTI S OCIALI', 'Fo g lio N.', 'Mod. Ce dolino TS'. Later documents (d96, d101-d104, ago2026) are clean, so label matching must be whitespace-insensitive to work across the whole corpus.

nodes.label: Code 2 - LAVORO ORDIN.(mens.)
nodes.rationale: The ordinary monthly salary line on every real ordinary-month payslip, always 1,00 x 2.615,39000 = 2.615,39. Absent from the tredicesima fixture (d13), which carries code 901 instead.

nodes.label: NETTO BUSTA (net pay)
nodes.rationale: The headline figure the dashboard consumes. In the real fixtures it is never labelled inline -- it surfaces as a bare rounded value in a trailing numeric row (e.g. 2.093,00 / 2.272,00 / 2.698,00), so it must be located positionally.

nodes.label: August 2026 PDF-Text Fixture (clean layout)
nodes.rationale: Hand-written, fully invented figures. Reproduces the TeamSystem 'Mod. Cedolino TS' layout documented in PLAN section 4 with employer Reply and all leave balances expressed in hours; the happy-path baseline the OCR fixture is degraded from.

nodes.label: Real Payslip Fixture: Luglio 2026 (doc 104, 730 refund)
nodes.rationale: Carries the Mod. 730 tax refund (608,00) and a compensated credit, inflating NETTO BUSTA far above the usual month; the fixture that stops net-pay trend logic from treating a 730 settlement as a raise.

nodes.label: Code 2161 - DONATORI SANGUE
nodes.rationale: Paid blood-donation leave, 6,67 hours, offsetting the identical ORE NON LAVORATE quantity on the same payslip. A leave category that must not be counted against the ferie or permessi balances.

nodes.label: Code 8003 - CONTRIBUZIONE TFR
nodes.rationale: Monthly TFR (severance) accrual paid into the pension fund, ~193,73 in ordinary months and higher in months carrying extra items (242,16 in d10). Synthetic fixtures use code 502 for the same component.

nodes.label: Code 9837 - IMPONIBILE 5% L.199/25
nodes.rationale: Base for the 5% substitute tax on productivity pay introduced by L.199/25. Appears only from June 2026 (d103, d104, ago2026), always immediately followed by code 9838.

nodes.label: Code 9838 - IMPOSTA SOST. 5% L.199/25
nodes.rationale: The 5% substitute tax itself, echoed on its own value line further down the payslip (e.g. a lone '2,90'), separate from the IRPEF chain.

nodes.label: Code 7101 - FONDO C/DIPE (employee pension-fund share)
nodes.rationale: Employee contribution to the complementary pension fund. Steps from 28,26 to 30,66 in June 2026 (d103), tracking the PAGA BASE recomposition. The synthetic fixtures label the same component with code 500.

nodes.label: Code 9109 - FONDO C/AZIENDA (employer pension-fund share)
nodes.rationale: Employer contribution to the complementary pension fund (51,81 -> 56,21 from June 2026). Appears in the COMPETENZE column although it never reaches net pay; the synthetic fixtures use code 501.

nodes.label: Code 9110 - COMUNICAZIONE DIPENDENTE
nodes.rationale: Informational mirror of FONDO C/DIPE (identical amount, 28,26 / 30,66). Double-counting it into contributions would inflate the deductions total.

nodes.label: Code 9424 - ULTERIORE DETRAZIONE MESE
nodes.rationale: The 2026-era additional monthly tax relief (76,71 - 84,93), successor to the 2025 TRATTAMENTO INT. DL 3/20 line.

nodes.label: Code 8992 - TRATTAMENTO INT. DL 3/20
nodes.rationale: Statutory supplementary treatment (ex bonus Renzi, DL 3/2020). Present only in the 2025 fixtures (d10, d12, d14) and replaced from 2026 by ULTERIORE DETRAZIONE MESE (9424) -- a year-boundary schema change the parser must survive.

nodes.label: PROGRESSIVI ANNUI Block
nodes.rationale: Final numeric row before the IBAN, holding year-to-date cumulatives (imponibile, ritenute, oneri deducibili, imponibile IRPEF, IRPEF annua, detrazioni, IRPEF netta). Monotonically increasing across d11 -> d15 -> d96 -> d101 -> d102 -> d103 -> d104 -> ago2026, which makes it a cheap cross-fixture consistency check.

nodes.label: Real Payslip Fixture: Ottobre 2025 (doc 14, partial month)
nodes.rationale: First month of employment (assunzione 13/10/25): carries GIORNI NON LAVORATI and a reduced gross, so it is the fixture for prorated first-month payslips.
nodes.norm_label: real payslip fixture: ottobre 2025 (doc 14, partial month)

nodes.label: Codice CCNL C011
nodes.rationale: The 'Codice CCNL: C011' line appears only on later payslips (d102, d103, d104, ago2026) and is absent from earlier ones -- an optional field the parser must tolerate missing.

nodes.label: Real Payslip Fixture: Maggio 2026 (doc 102, welfare)
nodes.rationale: Only fixture where TOTALE LORDO (2.815,39) exceeds the IRPEF taxable base (2.615,00) because of welfare reimbursements; the sample that proves gross must not be inferred from the taxable column.

nodes.label: Code 901 - 13^ MENSILITA'(hh)
nodes.rationale: Real tredicesima line, quantified in HOURS (43,25 x 15,11786 = 653,85) rather than as a 1,00 monthly unit -- the synthetic code 900 fixture models it as a unit, so the two disagree on shape.

nodes.label: MESE RETRIBUITO Pay-Period Line
nodes.rationale: Single value row combining pay period, filiale/cost codes, INPS matricola, cartellino and employee name, e.g. 'AGOSTO 2026 562 1 0000000000 91509307 525 ROSSI MARIO 13/10/25'. Carries either an Italian month name plus year or the literal '13a MENS. <year>' for tredicesima.

nodes.label: December 2026 Tredicesima Fixture (standalone document)
nodes.rationale: Models the normal path per PLAN section 4: the 13th-month payslip arrives as its OWN Paperless document, carrying no ordinary-salary row and no leave-residual grid, so the parser must not assume those sections are present.

nodes.label: Real Payslip Fixture: 13a Mensilita 2025 (doc 13)
nodes.rationale: The only real fixture whose MESE RETRIBUITO reads '13a MENS. 2025' instead of a month name; the canonical sample for tredicesima period detection and for negative-amount contribution rows.

nodes.label: Code 300 - ASSENZA X FERIE A.C.(hh)
nodes.rationale: Negative-amount deduction row (e.g. 8,00 x -15,11786 = -120,94). Always paired with code 301 for the same hours so the two cancel out in the gross; only the hours quantity is meaningful for leave tracking.
